title: Andrew Corcoran (B2B customer support leader, 20 years) on Incorruptible: 'my fave business book in many years'
summary: Andrew Corcoran, a customer support leader with 20 years building B2B software support organizations, says he has told everyone he knows that Incorruptible is a must read.
blockquote: I have told everyone I know that Incorruptible is a MUST READ book and that it’s my fave business book in many years.
attribution_title: Customer support leader · 20 years building B2B software support organizations
